review_notes: Reviewed the full 558-line target and checked the relevant Mathlib `finSuccEquiv_X_zero` declaration. I found one small proof simplification; I did not assess the proposed replacement by compiling it.

findings.excerpt:
have hinner :
      MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv K 1 (MvPolynomial.X 0) =
        (Polynomial.X : Polynomial (MvPolynomial (Fin 1) K)) := by
    rw [MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv_apply]
    simp
findings.problem: The proof reconstructs the standard image of `X 0` under `finSuccEquiv`, even though Mathlib provides a named theorem for this exact case.
findings.proposed_change: Remove the `hinner` block and retain the subsequent `rw [planeCurveToBivariate]` and `change`; then use `rw [MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv_X_zero]` before the final `simp`.
findings.benefit: This uses a well-named library lemma for the coordinate identification instead of reproving it through the implementation of `finSuccEquiv`. The mathematical point—that coordinate 0 becomes the outer polynomial variable—remains just as easy to see.

evidence.excerpt: theorem finSuccEquiv_X_zero : finSuccEquiv R n (X 0) = Polynomial.X := by simp [finSuccEquiv_apply]
